subject: Post-demo: Performance recap and decision criteria for FinOptima
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@finoptima.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & SLO checklist (post-demo)

Hi Tara —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap of the performance items we discussed so they’re captured for your decision team:

- Latency targets: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 350ms for short-chat queries (<= 256 tokens).
- Streaming/long-form: real-time token stream target p50 <= 30ms per token, p95 <= 120ms per token (we’ll validate with your 1k token use-case).
- Throughput & concurrency: steady-state target 450 concurrent streams / 1800 r/s aggregate for baseline; burst capacity to 3k r/s for short spikes.
- Concurrency behavior: session affinity required for KV cache warmness; we recommended pinned workers for 200+ long-lived sessions.
- Fallback policy: automatic fallback to quantized variant (q4f16) for degraded capacity while preserving semantics; degradation scenarios and expected latency ranges included in the attached SLO checklist.
- Measurement & telemetry: token-level breakdown, model-level cost by route, and per-request trace ids (we’ll hand over a short harness to run your synthetic load).

Next steps we agreed on:
1) Redwood to share an executable SLO checklist and a short perf test plan (attached).
2) FinOptima to provide representative prompt set + 3 sample convo traces (production-scrubbed) by 2026-06-04.
3) Alignment call with infra and procurement to confirm PO timelines (planning week of 6/8).

I’ve attached the SLO checklist and a CSV test plan — Marcus is copied for technical follow-up. If anything above is off, flag it and we’ll correct.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Date: 2026-06-02T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & SLO checklist (post-demo)

Tara —

Adding a few technical clarifications and the perf-harness link:

- The p95 numbers Laura listed assume a production-optimized shard (A100-class) with continuous batching disabled for low-latency routes. If you want lower median latency with fewer costly resources, we can enable aggressive KV caching and prefix caching at the cost of slightly higher p95 under burst.
- For streaming semantics: ensure the client supports incremental chunk-ACKs; the harness will surface per-chunk latencies.
- Concurrency: the 450 concurrent streams target is conservative based on your stated user concurrency pattern (2000 monthly active, 10% peak). If you expect higher tail concurrency, we recommend reserved Dedicated capacity with a soft autoscale buffer (20%).

Perf harness + docs: s3://redwood-internal/finoptima/perf-harness/README.md (internal link) — contains a small k6 script and an example JSON prompt bundle.

I’ve also attached a trimmed CSV that maps the FinOptima prompt categories to token-length buckets. We’ll iterate once we see your sample traces.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Laura / Marcus —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the harness link. A couple of clarifying points from our side before we loop in procurement:

1) Decision criteria: our engineering lead asked us to confirm three pass/fail items —
   a) Sustained 95th latency <= 400ms under our medium workload (sample attached).
   b) No more than 2% error/abort rate during a 30-minute full-scale run.
   c) Stream fidelity: incremental tokens must arrive in order with no reordering artifacts for >= 95% of events.

2) PO timing: procurement indicated they need a workshop + short run from Redwood to sign — can you support a two-hour on-site (remote) run in week of 6/8?

We will upload sanitized prompt traces by end of day 6/04 (attached). We also attached a short spreadsheet mapping our traffic buckets.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Product, FinOptima
tara@finoptima.com

Attachments: finoptima_sample_traces.json (sanitized), finoptima_traffic_buckets.xlsx

Tara —

We can run the two-hour workshop and live validation on Wednesday 2026-06-10 09:00 PT. Agenda we propose:

- 09:00–09:15: Kickoff, goals, and metrics (p50/p95 targets).
- 09:15–09:45: Provisioning & model selection (hosted vs dedicated, quantization trade-offs).
- 09:45–10:30: Live perf run with your sanitized traces (k6 harness) and streaming verification.
- 10:30–11:00: Results review, SLO pass/fail, and next action items (pricing/PO prep).

Action items for FinOptima before workshop:
- Upload representative prompt set and 3 convo traces (production-scrubbed) — thanks for committing to 6/04.
- Confirm preferred model variant and whether you require private deployment for compliance (if so, flag and we’ll bring the private deployment PM).

We’ll provision a dedicated test bucket and send an access link by EOD 6/08. If Wednesday doesn’t work, propose alternate slots and we’ll adjust.

Regards,
